crossrefs.text: What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.
If only you would remain silent; for that would be your wisdom!
Vengeance is Mine; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; for their day of disaster is near, and their doom is coming quickly.”
Does a wild donkey bray over fresh grass, or an ox low over its fodder?
Is tasteless food eaten without salt, or is there flavor in the white of an egg? My soul refuses to touch them; they are loathsome food to me.
Teach me, and I will be silent. Help me understand how I have erred. How painful are honest words! But what does your argument prove?

Please inquire of past generations and consider the discoveries of their fathers. For we were born yesterday and know nothing; our days on earth are but a shadow. Will they not teach you and tell you, and speak from their understanding?
The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; He blindfolds its judges. If it is not He, then who is it?
‘For in Him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are His offspring.’
The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
But Moses and Aaron fell facedown and said, “O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, when one man sins, will You be angry with the whole congregation?”
Nor is He served by human hands, as if He needed anything, because He Himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
as long as my breath is still within me and the breath of God remains in my nostrils,
so that all may see and know, may consider and understand, that the hand of the LORD has done this and the Holy One of Israel has created it.”
For the ear tests words as the mouth tastes food.
The ox knows its owner, and the donkey its masterʼs manger, but Israel does not know; My people do not understand.”
He reveals the deep and hidden things; He knows what lies in darkness, and light dwells with Him.

Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of menʼs hearts. At that time each will receive his praise from God.
But God has revealed it to us by the Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.
May darkness and gloom reclaim it, and a cloud settle over it; may the blackness of the day overwhelm it.
God is wise in heart and mighty in strength. Who has resisted Him and prospered?
It is not only the old who are wise, or the elderly who understand justice.
Indeed, God is mighty, but He despises no one; He is mighty in strength of understanding.
I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.
